body.name: Quadratic coherent nuisance remainder after support cleaning
body.construction:
Let
\[
 \kappa_{\mathrm{supp},n}
 =\frac{r_{A,\infty}+r_{Z,\infty}}{\tau_{S,n}},
 \qquad r_A^{\mathrm c}=r_A+\tau_{S,n},
 \qquad r_Z^{\mathrm c}=r_Z+\tau_{S,n},
\]
where \(r_A,r_Z\) are the conditional \(L^2(P)\) errors of the raw measurement fits and \(r_{A,\infty},r_{Z,\infty}\) are their essential-supremum errors.  Set
\[
\begin{aligned}
 R_{\Sigma}={}&r_m+r_\pi+r_A^{\mathrm c}+r_Z^{\mathrm c}+r_f+r_w+r_W+r_B+r_d+r_D+r_R+r_N+r_h+r_G+r_b\\
 &+r_{A,\infty}+r_{Z,\infty}+r_{G,\infty},\\
 \Delta_n={}&r_m(r_\pi+r_A^{\mathrm c}+r_Z^{\mathrm c})
 +r_A^{\mathrm c}r_Z^{\mathrm c}
 +(r_A^{\mathrm c}+r_Z^{\mathrm c})R_{\Sigma}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus \(\kappa_{\mathrm{supp},n}\) is recorded separately from the aggregate score error \(R_\Sigma\), and \(\Delta_n\) contains no additive leakage allowance.
